name: freespace-open-language-server
description: Language support and tools for FreeSpace Open modding: tables, models, missions and more.

commands.title: Open 3D POF Viewer at Position (FSO Table)

fsoLsp.unknownFieldSeverity.description: How to report a $Field:/+Field: this extension doesn't recognize for the table it appears in. A field known to belong to a DIFFERENT table (e.g. a weapons.tbl field pasted into ships.tbl) is always reported as a warning regardless of this setting - this only controls fields unrecognized by every schema this extension knows about, which may simply be real, newer FSO fields it hasn't been taught about yet.

fsoLsp.trimSharedSourcePrefix.description: In the effective-definition hover's 'Layers applied' list and field table, strip the longest path prefix shared by every source shown (e.g. a common 'E:\Games\Knossos\FS2\' folder) so it isn't repeated on every line.

enumDescriptions: Only validate documents you currently have open - the default, cheapest option.

Also scan every loose .tbl/.tbm file across the active mod's search path (its own tables plus its dependencies'), so cross-reference problems show up in the Problems panel even for files you haven't opened. Re-scans automatically when a table file changes.
fsoLsp.validationScope.description: Which files get diagnostics: just the ones open in the editor, or every table file in the active mod.
